snippet.title: "Jantar Mantar किसी के बाप का नहीं है..." महिलाओं की पुलिसकर्मियों से झड़प | CJP Protest | Gyanesh
snippet.description:
"Is Jantar Mantar anyone's father's property?" A woman protester argued with Delhi Police personnel at the Barakhamba Road roundabout on Saturday (October 10). She was on her way to the Cockroach Janta Party's (CJP) protest at Jantar Mantar, called to demand the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar.

The woman, who says she is from Burari in Delhi and heads her area's RWA, objects to women police personnel touching her. She asks why police do not act against the drug abuse that is ruining families in every home. She is later put into a bus and detained. A man who says a living member of his family has been removed from the voter list is also taken away.

Citing prohibitory orders under Section 163 of the BNSS, police are not letting even four or five people gather at the spot. People are being filled into DTC buses that would normally run on city routes. Among those stopped is a man who says he was simply going to his job in Connaught Place and is worried about losing a day's pay. Media teams were also not allowed past the roundabout, and the internet was down in the area. Watch the ground report.

"Is Jantar Mantar anyone's father's property?" A woman protester argued with Delhi Police personnel at the Barakhamba Road roundabout on Saturday (October 10). She was on her way to the Cockroach Janta Party's (CJP) protest at Jantar Mantar, called to demand the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar.

The woman, who says she is from Burari in Delhi and heads her area's RWA, objects to women police personnel touching her. She asks why police do not act against the drug abuse that is ruining families in every home. She is later put into a bus and detained. A man who says a living member of his family has been removed from the voter list is also taken away.

Citing prohibitory orders under Section 163 of the BNSS, police are not letting even four or five people gather at the spot. People are being filled into DTC buses that would normally run on city routes. Among those stopped is a man who says he was simply going to his job in Connaught Place and is worried about losing a day's pay. Media teams were also not allowed past the roundabout, and the internet was down in the area. Watch the ground report.

snippet.title: Frank Just Thought the Fish Wasn’t Salty Enough 😂🐟💀 | It’s Always Sunny in Philadelphia
snippet.description:
HE BROUGHT HIS OWN ANCHOVIES TO A FANCY RESTAURANT. 😭🧂🔥

It’s Always Sunny in Philadelphia | Season 16, Episode 2 🎬

There are picky eaters…

And then there is Frank Reynolds. 😂

Dennis Reynolds and Dee Reynolds take Frank out for a nice dinner.

On the surface, they are being incredibly sweet.

They are smiling.

They are agreeing with everything he says.

They are treating him like royalty. 👑

But Frank knows exactly what is happening.

This is not just a family dinner.

Dennis and Dee want MONEY. 💰😂

They are hoping that if they keep Frank happy enough, maybe he will remember them when it comes time to divide up his fortune.

So they are willing to tolerate almost anything.

And Frank immediately tests that theory. 💀

While everyone else is eating normal restaurant food, Frank casually pulls out something he brought from home.

A CAN OF ANCHOVIES. 🐟😭

Dennis looks at him like:

“What are you doing?”

Frank gives the simplest explanation imaginable:

The fish in this restaurant is not salty enough.

That’s it.

That is the entire problem. 😂🧂

Apparently the professional chef did not meet Frank Reynolds’ personal sodium requirements…

So Frank came prepared.

He opens his own anchovies and starts adding them directly to the meal.

At a nice restaurant.

In front of everyone. 💀

Dennis and Dee clearly know this behavior is completely insane.

But remember…

They want Frank’s money.

So suddenly they become the most supportive people on Earth. 🤣

Frank says the food has no taste.

Dennis and Dee immediately agree.

“Yeah.”

“Not salty enough.”

Of course, it is probably already incredibly salty.

But nobody is going to argue with the rich old man they are trying to impress. 😂🔥

Dennis even points out that they do a pretty good job pretending Frank is not an animal.

Which might be the most accurate description of the entire situation. 💀

Frank does whatever he wants.

Brings outside food.

Ignores restaurant etiquette.

Handles a gun at the table.

And Dennis and Dee just keep smiling because there might be inheritance money at the end of this nightmare. 😭💰

That is classic Always Sunny.

Nobody is actually being nice.

Everyone has an angle.

Frank knows they want his fortune.

Dennis and Dee know Frank is behaving horribly.

And yet everyone continues pretending because selfishness is stronger than common sense. 😂

snippet.title: Strefa 51: co ujawniły odtajnione dokumenty?
snippet.description:
Zapraszam do głosowania na nagrodę Śląskiego Festiwalu Nauki, pamiętajcie, że potem jeszcze trzeba kliknąć w link potweirdzający: 

https://slaskifestiwalnauki.pl/glosowanie-pop-science-2026


Co naprawdę ukrywa Strefa 51? Historia tajnej bazy Area 51 w Nevadzie łączy UFO, samoloty szpiegowskie CIA i operacje, o których przez lata nie wolno było mówić.

W 1963 roku Ken Collins katapultował się z tajnego samolotu A-12 OXCART. Gdy na miejsce dotarli przypadkowi świadkowie, trzeba było ochronić sekret całego programu. Wrak zebrano, a prasie podano, że rozbiła się zupełnie inna maszyna. Ta historia otwiera opowieść o tym, co rzeczywiście działo się nad wyschniętym jeziorem Groom Lake.

Przyglądam się samolotom U-2 i A-12, rozwojowi technologii stealth oraz testom zdobycznego radzieckiego MiG-a-21. Wyjaśniam też, dlaczego samolot lecący wysoko nad ziemią może świecić w promieniach słońca, kiedy obserwatorzy na dole widzą już ciemne niebo. Ten mechanizm pomaga zrozumieć część historycznych doniesień o UFO.

Sprawdzam również opowieści Boba Lazara o statkach kosmitów, napędzie antygrawitacyjnym i pierwiastku 115. Co potwierdzają odtajnione dokumenty CIA? Gdzie kończą się udokumentowane eksperymenty wojskowe, a zaczynają hipotezy i teorie spiskowe?

To historia Strefy 51 oparta na dokumentach, historii lotnictwa i fizyce. Pokazuje, jak wojskowa tajemnica, mylące wyjaśnienia i ludzkie oczekiwania mogły wspólnie budować legendę bazy.
